version_note: V3.1.5: conserva barrenos PTH <25 mm y fuerza cut_outer desde Y_DXF máximo, con X_DXF máximo como desempate.
main_changes: Preserved the complete cama A geometry, normalization, ordering and entry methodology.
Forced robot_programming.robot=3 and calibrated scene identity L3.
Added R3_A_240X96_E1_J2_V1.json with the 25 supplied 5x5 measurements.
Changed active policy IDs, validation and motion-map metadata from R4 to R3.
Kept normalization margin 20 mm, column band 100 mm and individual hole E1_fixed logic.
Preserved the generator escuadra P[1]..P[6] exactly as confirmed by the user.
Added post-focus anti-false-text guard: text blocks longer than TEXT_COMPONENT_MAX_LONG_DIM_MM are reassigned to mark_figure without changing compact real text policy.
Decoupled detected PLATE/bbox dimensions from the fixed 6096x2438 programming envelope.
Allows smaller or nonstandard source plate sizes when the useful normalized nesting fits the 240x96 envelope.
Reports detected nesting size and source in LS-ready JSON and generator report.
Keeps hard rejection for normalized geometry outside 6096x2438.
Circular holes with diameter under 25 mm use 10 CNT40 PTH to the first cut point, 10 CNT60 PTH on arc 1, and 7 CNT40 PTH on arc 2.
Circular holes with diameter 25 mm or greater keep the standard 35 mm/sec, CNT50, FINE profile.
All linear hole motions omit COORD because every hole path uses a fixed E1 value.
Outer cut entry now prioritizes maximum Y_DXF and uses maximum X_DXF only as a tie-breaker, preventing diagonal-side starts at mid-height.
